reason: The cited evidence shows Y₂O₃ refines grains and improves room-temperature strength in a NiCoCr superalloy (E1) and enhances high-temperature strength and ductility in a NiCoCr medium-entropy alloy (E2), but neither study involves a Ti–Ni high-entropy alloy or the specific processing route (resonant acoustic mixing + LPBF), so the key premise that these benefits transfer to the proposed Ti–Ni system is unsupported.
premises: Y₂O₃ nanoparticles refine grain structure in additively manufactured alloys
Y₂O₃ nanoparticles increase tensile strength at room temperature
Y₂O₃ nanoparticles improve ductility at elevated temperature
Grain refinement by Y₂O₃ is due to grain boundary pinning
Y₂O₃ benefits apply to Ti–Ni high-entropy alloy processed by laser powder bed fusion
